paragraphs.intro: I'm a Software Engineer with deep expertise in backend technologies and system architecture. With 3+ years of hands-on experience building production-grade applications, I specialize in Node.js, Python (FastAPI/Django), and cloud-native solutions on AWS.
paragraphs.experience: From designing RESTful APIs and microservices to deploying containerized applications with Docker, I bring ideas to life through clean, scalable code. I've built SaaS platforms, BaaS solutions, and enterprise systems that handle millions of requests.
paragraphs.company: As the founder of {{company}}, I lead a team delivering full-stack solutions with a backend-first approach. Whether it's architecting databases, implementing caching strategies with Redis, or setting up CI/CD pipelines—I ensure every system is built for scale.
